intent: I need a very slow, restful reading tonight.
Make this a fast, energetic reading. I only have five minutes.
Read in complete silence. No music or soundscape.
Give me a soft atmospheric soundscape under the words.
Keep the screen still and spare. No moving visuals.
I want vivid psychedelic color and an immersive moving visual field, without flashes.
Use a calm literary serif face, like a book page.
Give me strong bold geometric lettering that commands the screen.
Keep the words small and unobtrusive on screen.
Make the text large and easy to read from across the room.
Slow words, a literary serif, small type, complete silence, and no moving pictures.
Fast phrases, bold large type, an atmospheric soundscape, and vivid psychedelic visuals.
